actors.role: Founder managing own treasury and token inventory
actors.goal: Maximize final own cash after campaign costs over 48h while protecting the 43000 USD liquid sleeve from speculative losses. Compare gradual inventory sales, waiting, purchases and paid visibility; no claim of guaranteed profit. Private messages are proposals, not binding agreements.

actors.role: Independent market maker with own inventory and budget
actors.goal: Protect own 2000 USD cash sleeve and manage 100M hypothetical tokens, considering pool depth, recent fills, fees and adverse selection. Independently accept or ignore founder requests; no wash trading or guaranteed support.

actors.role: Marketing partner managing a prepaid campaign budget
actors.goal: Use at most the own 2000 USD campaign sleeve responsibly. Choose a publication only when timing and audience relevance justify cost. Coordinate privately with founder and assess visible campaign results; do not promise demand.

actors.role: Disclosed independent marketing persona with hypothetical token compensation
actors.goal: Protect own cash and reputation; evaluate public signals before holding, selling or buying. Disclose uncertainty and do not infer private founder or MM instructions.
Manage own 30M hypothetical tokens and 300 USD cash for continuity, participation and downside protection. Consider campaign expiry, public momentum and liquidity, without private team access.

Seek favorable own short-term cash returns with at most 200 USD total initial cash. Consider executed volume, price momentum and promotion expiry. Buy, sell or wait based on visible state; paid visibility alone is not evidence of demand.

Protect own 500 USD cash and wait for credible evidence of sustainable participation. Consider several recent states and cash reserve depth before committing small purchases or exiting existing inventory.

Protect own 100 USD cash. Treat promotion as advertising, not verified endorsement. Look for thin liquidity, reversals and narrative expiry; avoid buying when evidence is weak, and reduce an existing position if conditions deteriorate.

Private proposal: preserve budget and observe organic reactions rather than spend now. Independently reassess this request next step.

Private response: favor observing actual public fills and campaign response before proposing additional risk.
Private marketing message: compare delivery delay, remaining budget and campaign expiry before committing more exposure spending.
Public opinion from the KOL persona: advertising and token-related claims are not verified demand; independently assess current liquidity and risk.
Public ecosystem opinion: compare actual recent turnover and campaign expiry with the current narrative before taking risk.

assumptions: This is a synthetic mechanics experiment, not a calibrated launch forecast, investment recommendation or observed MACRON market.
User-specified launch clock, expected 10-15min curve window and founder cash objective are retained. A real political or macroeconomic event schedule has not been supplied or verified.
The initial constant-product pool replaces, rather than implements, the bonding curve. Snipers, graduation, new external arrivals, MEV, LP ownership and liquidation of LP shares are unsupported.

All initial token allocations and actor cash sleeves are hypothetical. Founder-controlled initial capital is 50000 USD: 43000 cash plus 2000 marketing budget plus 5000 pool cash. Partner and retail cash are separate assumed resources.
Signals are finite authorized proposals delivered next step. They are opinions, not binding contracts or verification of trades. Private founder/MM/marketing signals are never delivered to retail.
Uncalibrated stress-event probabilities and KOL delivery probability are input assumptions. No 6-12 month historical cohort has been fitted. No real announcement or promotion purchase is made.

Boost pack pricing is unverified and excluded. Enhanced Token Info is distinct from listing and Boosts; current 299 USD offer is a later-sourced product assumption, not an as-of launch price guarantee.

Paid visibility never directly changes price or volume. Only independently selected, successfully settled actor trades do. Eight actors are illustrative agents, not an estimate of the full addressable retail population.

The model supplies typed action and signal scores, not free-text explanations or calibrated event odds. Scores below the fixed 0.6 confidence gate cause waiting/silence; rejected and abstained choices remain in receipts.
Four seeds explore mechanics; they cannot support reliable tail probabilities. Do not turn four paths into a claim about the chance of 5M market cap or future founder profit.
